facts_raw.Foundshore Verdict: 低优先级 / 仅特定场景
facts_raw.Funding / Support: Current 2026 Antler Australia materials describe A$260K investment for backed companies
facts_raw.Capital Disclosure Status: Verified — Amount Public / Exact Current Equity Terms Need Offer Docs
facts_raw.Can Apply Solo: Yes to residency; Antler says it does not invest in solo founders
facts_raw.Official / Must-Have Requirements: Inception/pre-seed; industry agnostic; meaningful full-time building. Already meaningful pre-seed may be too late.
facts_raw.Strong-to-Have: 全职创始团队；清晰 founder-market fit；可演示产品/MVP；真实用户/客户验证；明确下一阶段里程碑与融资用途。
facts_raw.On-site / Attendance: 8-week residency run in Sydney/Melbourne/Brisbane, twice a year.
facts_raw.Visa / Relocation: 未见公开统一签证支持；若需赴美/赴欧线下参加，必须自行确认合法入境与停留资格。
facts_raw.Application Materials: 通常需团队/公司/产品/市场/traction/融资信息；具体以当期官方申请表为准。
facts_raw.Public Contact Route: 官方申请入口优先；若官网未公开联系人，不建议猜测个人联系方式。
facts_raw.Foundshore Best Fit: 高增长科技创业；阶段以 Pre-seed 为主。
facts_raw.Foundshore Not Fit: 已进入成熟增长期、仅寻求销售渠道而非创业加速的公司

facts.Funding / Support: Current 2026 Antler Australia materials describe A$260K investment for backed companies
facts.Capital Disclosure Status: Verified — Amount Public / Exact Current Equity Terms Need Offer Docs
facts.Can Apply Solo: Yes to residency; Antler says it does not invest in solo founders
facts.Official / Must-Have Requirements: Inception/pre-seed; industry agnostic; meaningful full-time building. Already meaningful pre-seed may be too late.
facts.Strong-to-Have: Full-time founders, clear founder-market fit, a demonstrable MVP, customer validation and explicit milestones and funding needs.

facts.Public Contact Route: Use the official application. Do not infer private contact information when none is published.
facts.Foundshore Best Fit: High-growth technology startups; primarily at the Pre-seed stage.
facts.Foundshore Not Fit: Mature growth companies seeking sales channels rather than acceleration
